resolution.note: main() guarantees one verdict line: early exits print 'fast FAIL (<stage>): exit N', crashes 'fast FAIL (<stage>): crashed: ...'; regression test covers git exit and index crash

title: npm run fast always ends with a verdict line
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16 worktree publish-guards: the first `npm run fast` exited 1 printing only the npm banner, no 'fast PASS/FAIL' line; an immediate rerun on the same tree printed 'fast PASS'. Log lost (overwritten).
Outcome: every exit of scripts/fast-check.ts prints a verdict line naming the failing stage, including crashes before the first stage.
Why: an exit 1 with no verdict forces a blind rerun and hides a flake.
Proof: a test that makes the first stage throw sees a 'fast FAIL' line with the stage name.
Files: scripts/fast-check.ts
